caseNameFull: Shalala, Secretary of Health and Human Services v. Grijalva

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of American Mfrs. Mut. Ins. Co. v. Sullivan, ante, p. 40; §§4001 and 4002 of the Balanced Budget Act of 1997, Pub. L. 105-33, 111 Stat. 275-330; and the regulations of the Secretary of Health and Human Services implementing those provisions.
